headline: Board held two tenant-landlord hearings and closed both for private deliberation
summary: The board heard two cases: Ramash Dahal versus Dennis Rouille regarding 75 Shelburne Street, Unit 1, and Megan Kelly versus Mark Lundie regarding 112 Church Street. In both cases, parties presented evidence and testimony, and the hearings were closed. The board then deliberated in private, and the minutes do not record any decision.
plain_text:
BURLINGTON HOUSING BOARD OF REVIEW  
Monday, August 24, 2026 6:30 p.m.  
** REMOTE and IN PERSON**  
645 Pine Street, Front Conference Room OR  
Remotely via Zoom https://zoom.us/j/93090493672  
 
Minutes  
  
Board Members present: Joshua Wronski, Olivia Taylor, Emma Ramirez-Richer,  
Staff present: Shay Brunvand

1. Ramash Dahal (tenant); Dennis Rouille (landlord) Re: 75 Shelburne Street, Unit 1 
Present were Ramash Dahal, Umeri Rijal, Dennis Rouille and Kim Rouille 
Jeetan Khadka appeared as an interpreter.  
Both parties presented their evidence and testimony. The hearing was closed.  
 
2. Megan Kelly (tenant); Mark Lundie (landlord) Re: 112 Church Street, Burlington, VT 05401

closed.  
 
The meeting was adjourned at 8:24 
 
The Board deliberated in private.
